notes: FIXTURE example at the intended initial scale: 128 x 128 cells of 0.25 m (32 m x 32 m). Covers and diameters are illustrative fixtures, not calibrations. Initial ages use the species-linked rule {"distribution": "uniform_to_life_expectancy"} (also the default when initial_age_days is omitted): each plant's age is drawn independently and uniformly from 0 to its species' nominal life_expectancy in the catalog (fixture catalog: grass 8 years, shrub 40 years); that is an initial sampling range, not a death age. Explicit controls (a number of days, constant, bounded uniform) remain available for fixtures. Copy and edit. Switch overlap to "disallowed" for large-canopy-first global canopy exclusion.
